## Fix (only under `source/`)

1. `GraphMol/MolStandardize/Tautomer.cpp` (root cause): a stereo descriptor is only transferred to the transformed bond when it is meaningful there — `STEREONONE`/`STEREOANY` always, cis/trans-type labels only if the source bond really is a double bond with its two stereo atoms.
